title: CLERUS
descriptions: A structured dataset with careers of Dutch Protestant ministers from 1555 until 2004 is created out of a series of semi-structured data sources that are the result of archival historical research. CLERUS_v1 contains all ministers until 1816.
description: A structured dataset with careers of Dutch Protestant ministers from 1555 until 2004 is created out of a series of semi-structured data sources that are the result of archival historical research. CLERUS_v1 contains all ministers until 1816.
spatial_coverage: It contains all protestant reformed ministers that acted as such in the Netherlands between 1550 and 1816. For some it also contains information about areas outside of the Netherlands, but this is not fully complete.
